name: scenescout-marketplace
description: SceneScout: exploratory UI testing for any web app, driven by Claude.

plugins.name: scenescout
plugins.description: Exploratory UI testing: browser tools that let Claude explore a running web app like a curious user, find what is broken or confusing, and write a coverage-checked report.

plugins.name: scenescout-mod
plugins.description: Optional Claude Code mod: a run pane that refreshes itself (/scenescout-pane) and an opt-in model for lane agents. Runs unsandboxed in the Claude Code CLI and the desktop Code tab; install scenescout first.
